# American Action Forum

> Forward-thinking policy analysis and economic research on regulation, trade, financial services, and labor policy.

The American Action Forum is a think tank that provides comprehensive policy analysis and economic research on critical issues affecting American competitiveness and governance. The organization publishes work across multiple policy domains including financial regulation, international trade, healthcare, and labor markets.

## Key Topics

- Policy Analysis
- Economic Research
- Regulation Tracker
- Financial Services
- Trade Policy
- Healthcare Policy
- Labor Policy
- Congressional Review
- Federal Reserve
- Basel III Endgame
- Jones Act
- IEEPA
- FTC
- LNG
